definition: a person who moved to live in a new country
description: At night outside an airport arrivals building in falling snow, a young man in a denim jacket and patterned shirt, with a backpack, looks up in wonder at the snowflakes, a big brown suitcase and a cardboard box tied with string at his feet. A young woman in a bobble hat and dark parka wraps a thick hooded winter coat with a fur collar around his shoulders. He pulls it closed, laughs and keeps staring up at the snow. Other travellers pull suitcases past waiting taxis, and city towers glow behind.

to wrap a parka around him

de.answer: Sie legt ihm einen Parka um.
de.question: Was macht die Frau gerade?
